references.text: Refers to the Anakim as a great and tall people, the same description as in Deut. 2:21
Describes how the Lord destroyed the former inhabitants and let another people take their place, the same pattern as with the Anakim
Mentions the Anakim as a great and tall people whom no one can stand against
First mention of the Anakim as a strong people in the land of Canaan
Describes the Anakim as giants, descendants of Anak
Joshua destroyed the Anakim from the hill country, fulfilling the Lord's promise to destroy them
Caleb drove out the Anakim from Hebron, showing that the Lord gave victory over this feared people
Mentions Og, king of Bashan, as the last of the Rephaim, a people related to the giants
